exclude.reason: a GitOps example directory holding a vendored install manifest of another project's controllers and the kustomization that lists it; none of it is the operator's API
exclude.evidence: Listed at v0.34.0 and v0.38.1: the directory holds exactly gotk-components.yaml, gotk-sync.yaml and kustomization.yaml. The manifest defines ten CustomResourceDefinitions in the toolkit.fluxcd.io API groups, none in a mariadb group; the kustomization lists it under resources. The operator's own definitions are the nine under config/crd/bases; the full-tree scan of v0.34.0 to v0.38.0 reports this manifest as its only extra definition file.
